$description: Token proposals for ChatsPanel (carbon-labs v12). Moves to packages/themes at graduation, or is dropped if Carbon covers it another way. Values are aliases to Carbon's own tokens where one exists.

shell-chat-hover.$description: A hovered row in the PUSHED panel, which is a column of the shell and paints no surface of its own — so its rows rest on the page and hover is one step from it, 0.94 light and 0.24 dark. The overlay's rows rest on the panel instead and are a step further; that is the stacking rule, not an inconsistency. Falls back to $layer-hover.

shell-chat-current.$description: The current row in the PUSHED panel: two steps from the page, 0.91 light and 0.28 dark. Falls back to $layer-selected.

chat-hover.$description: A hovered chat row. The ladder counted from the surface the row rests on: hover one step. The same blue-gray the menus hover on, so a row in the panel and a row in a menu behave alike. Falls back to $layer-hover. Counted from the surface the row rests on, which is the panel, not the page (the stacking rule): a floating surface is already one step up, so its states are one step further. Resolved from the shared menu-* rungs, not picked by hand.

chat-current.$description: The chat the person is in. Selected is two steps on the same ladder — one rung past hover, so moving the pointer over the current row does not make it look like a different state. Falls back to $layer-selected. Counted from the surface the row rests on, which is the panel, not the page (the stacking rule): a floating surface is already one step up, so its states are one step further. Resolved from the shared menu-* rungs, not picked by hand.

shell-chat-current-text.$description: The label of the current row in the PUSHED panel: the brand blue solved for contrast on chats-panel-shell-chat-current. Hover stays $text-primary; blue is kept for selected. The fill is the surface selected step, the same as mega-button-selected-fill, so the value is identical to mega-button-selected-text. Falls back to $text-primary.

chat-current-text.$description: The label of the current row in the overlay: the brand blue solved for contrast on chats-panel-chat-current. Identical to session-switcher-menu-selected-text, because both rows rest on the menu surface at the selected step. Falls back to $text-primary. Resolved from the shared menu-* rungs, not picked by hand.
